messages:
morgan: heads up — i'm opening a small TF refactor PR to hoist provider blocks and pin versions for aws/google. will need eyeballs on secrets wiring for k8s-module.

alex: can you paste the plan or link the PR? quick check only

morgan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 — main changes: module reorg, provider hoist, lockfile regen. plan attached from CI output.

infra-bot: workspace: prod-us (plan) — 3 to add, 2 to change, 0 to destroy

sanjay: quick q: are we keeping legacy `secret_path` input on the k8s module? the refactor seems to remove it

morgan: good catch — i removed secret_path in favor of `secret_ref` map to standardize across modules. but i kept a backwards-compat shim in module_root/vars.tf

lee: do we have an automated migration for existing envs? removing inputs can break staging

morgan: shim maps `secret_path` => `secret_ref` if provided. snippet:
```
variable "secret_ref" {
  type = map(string)
  default = {}
}
locals {
  merged_secret = length(var.secret_ref) > 0 ? var.secret_ref : (var.secret_path != "" ? { "default" = var.secret_path } : {})
}
```

alex: looks fine but that var.secret_path != "" check won't work for lists. old module used list(string).

morgan: ah — thanks. PR updated to handle both list and string. new local uses can(index) pattern; pushed a commit.

sanjay: also we need to ensure provider pin in root modules doesn't force a lockfile regen on dependent repos. plan shows provider v4.12.0 -> v4.13.1

morgan: intended; we pinned to v4.13.1 because it fixes kinesis client bug. but i can make it a soft pin (>= 4.13.1) to avoid strict mismatches

lee: can we instead pin only the module that requires it, bump minimal constraint, and run `terraform providers lock` in a controlled rollout? don't want infra churn across teams

morgan: agree. updated to >= 4.13.1 in root and left modules unconstrained. also added a note in CHANGELOG and migration doc.

alex: did CI run `terraform plan` with provider mirror? any provider constraint conflicts in the lockfile change?

infra-bot: CI: terraform-plan (branch m/refactor-provider-hoist) — success. lockfile updated: providers.lock generated

sanjay: please add a short migration snippet in the PR description that tells people to `terraform init -upgrade` and commit new lockfile if they manage their own state

morgan: done. also added k8s secret wiring test in staging (applied minimal manifest). output: pods started, secrets mounted.

lee: I'll do a quick review in the morning. if nobody objects, we can merge after a 24h soak in staging

alex: left a couple inline comments about docstrings and the list/string handling — small

morgan: thanks! tagging @infra for awareness

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled CI check rerun in 2h

morgan: ping me if any regressions. I'm around for the merge window tomorrow 10–12 PT

sanjay: ack

lee: ack

alex: ack :thumbsup:
